verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the homepage claim that you can 'check every branch before it runs' on flows. That gives a thin pre-launch review step for workflows. Separate Sites for production and testing could serve as a manual staging workaround. Missing for 10: any documented version history for workflows or sequences, change review or approval, rollback to a prior version, and export of automations as code via the CLI or API.
